text: Municipal Licensing and Standards will provide an update on the actions summarized in 2025.EX28.2 , per direction from City Council, which includes strengthening enforcement processes, improving staff training, and establishing stronger protocols for interdivisional coordination to better protect tenants affected by vital services disruptions.
The Housing Rights Advisory Committee: 1. Deferred consideration of the item until the June 22, 2026 meeting of the Housing Rights Advisory Committee.
